quests.dispatcherQuestion: Simultaneous CBRN threats across multiple sectors requiring a unified response. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the unified CBRN response code.
quests.explanation: Unified CBRN codes deploy coordinated specialist teams for all four threat types simultaneously under joint command.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Prioritization needed when CBRN resources are insufficient for all active threats. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement CBRN resource triage.
quests.explanation: CBRN resource triage assigns available teams based on population at risk, agent severity, and mitigation effectiveness.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International CBRN mutual assistance being requested from treaty partners. Input code!
quests.hint: Request international CBRN assistance.
quests.explanation: International CBRN assistance from treaty partners provides specialized personnel and equipment beyond national capacity.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Deep-space mission experiencing primary life support failure six months from Earth. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the deep-space emergency response protocol.
quests.explanation: Deep-space emergency protocols maximize remaining life support margins and calculate the earliest possible return trajectory.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crew of four must ration remaining oxygen and CO2 scrubbing chemicals urgently. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement life support rationing protocol.
quests.explanation: Life support rationing protocols calculate consumption rates to extend survival time while engineering solutions are developed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency trajectory burn required to shorten the return mission duration significantly. Input code!
quests.hint: Calculate and execute the emergency trajectory burn.
quests.explanation: Emergency trajectory burns use remaining propellant in a calculated compromise between fuel consumption and return time reduction.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Complex nuclear power plant accident involving multiple simultaneous system failures. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the complex nuclear accident protocol.
quests.explanation: Complex accident protocols allow simultaneous management of multiple failure modes that individual procedures do not address.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multiple redundant safety systems failed, requiring manual backup procedures only. Input code!
quests.hint: Switch to manual backup operations.
quests.explanation: Manual backup procedures are written for scenarios where both primary and redundant systems have failed simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: External emergency response from neighboring nuclear operators being requested. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate owner-controlled emergency support.
quests.explanation: Owner-controlled support brings personnel and equipment from unaffected nuclear sites to assist a stricken plant.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Advanced biological containment breach with confirmed airborne transmission. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate airborne pathogen containment.
quests.explanation: Airborne containment protocols establish negative pressure zones, HEPA filtration perimeters, and respiratory protection requirements.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All potentially exposed individuals requiring level-4 personal protective equipment. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue level-4 PPE to all exposed personnel.
quests.explanation: Level-4 PPE provides the highest protection against airborne biological threats including positive pressure suits.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Laboratory confirmation of the airborne transmission route needed within two hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Confirm the airborne transmission route urgently.
quests.explanation: Rapid transmission route confirmation allows public health authorities to deploy the correct protection measures immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Trans-national infrastructure emergency affecting three neighboring countries simultaneously. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate trans-national emergency coordination.
quests.explanation: Trans-national emergency coordination activates cross-border mutual aid obligations and unified command structures.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Different national legal frameworks complicating cross-border emergency operations. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate legal harmonization for cross-border operations.
quests.explanation: Legal harmonization identifies the highest common authority allowing operations to proceed across jurisdictional boundaries.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Shared infrastructure restoration requiring simultaneous multi-country coordinated action. Input code!
quests.hint: Coordinate multi-nation infrastructure restoration.
quests.explanation: Multi-nation restoration sequences actions across countries to prevent asynchronous recovery from creating new instabilities.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear submarine experiencing a reactor emergency in an international shipping lane. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a maritime nuclear emergency notification.
quests.explanation: Maritime nuclear emergency notifications alert all vessels in the area and activate coastal state emergency obligations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coastal state requesting the submarine move to the designated emergency anchorage. Input code!
quests.hint: Proceed to the designated emergency anchorage.
quests.explanation: Emergency anchorages for nuclear vessels are pre-designated locations with monitoring and specialized response infrastructure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International Atomic Energy Agency notification required within 24 hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the IAEA notification code.
quests.explanation: IAEA notification of maritime nuclear incidents triggers international monitoring and technical advisory support.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Magnitude 8.1 earthquake strikes the urban core with total infrastructure failure. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the total infrastructure failure protocol.
quests.explanation: Total infrastructure failure protocols establish alternative systems for command, communications, and life safety simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multiple hospital collapses require all casualty management in field conditions. Input code!
quests.hint: Convert to total field medical operations.
quests.explanation: Total field medical operations deploy military field hospitals and surgical teams to compensate for collapsed civilian hospitals.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International heavy rescue teams arriving requiring immediate operational sector assignment. Input code!
quests.hint: Assign international rescue teams to sectors.
quests.explanation: Sector-based assignment of international teams provides geographic accountability and prevents resource overlap.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nation-state cyber attack disabling power grid protection systems nationwide. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the state cyber attack on power grid response.
quests.explanation: State cyber attack responses engage government cyber agencies, military cyber units, and utility security teams jointly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Physical protection of exposed substations required alongside the cyber defense. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy physical security to all substations.
quests.explanation: Physical substation security prevents saboteurs from exploiting cyber-blind periods to cause physical equipment damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National cyber force retaliatory options being prepared by defense authorities. Input code!
quests.hint: Prepare national cyber retaliation options.
quests.explanation: Preparing retaliation options provides diplomatic leverage for de-escalation while demonstrating deterrent capability.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Storm surge, wildfire, and coastal earthquake creating simultaneous compound hazards. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the multi-hazard coastal emergency code.
quests.explanation: Multi-hazard codes deploy specialized teams for each threat type while preventing responders from entering hazard zones unaware.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Wildfire cutting inland evacuation routes from the coastal storm surge zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Authorize sea-based evacuation only.
quests.explanation: Sea-based evacuation by boat and helicopter bypasses wildfire-blocked roads and remains viable despite storm surge conditions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Earthquake damage weakening coastal cliffs and increasing landslide probability. Input code!
quests.hint: Clear all personnel from the cliff zones.
quests.explanation: Cliff zone clearance removes personnel from the footprint of potential seismically-weakened coastal landslides.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Continuity of government being activated due to an existential threat to leadership. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the continuity of government plan.
quests.explanation: Continuity of government activation transfers authority to designated successors and relocates essential functions to secure sites.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Essential government functions being transferred to the protected alternate facility. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the alternate government facility.
quests.explanation: Alternate facilities are hardened locations with independent power, communications, and administration for government continuity.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Public communications must be maintained to prevent panic during the government transfer. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a public calm briefing.
quests.explanation: Calm public briefings provide factual information and clear instructions, reducing panic-driven behavior during government transitions.
